name: paladin
description: Security review for PRs, local repositories, and vulnerability mitigation planning.

interface.shortDescription: Catch practical security issues before merge.
interface.longDescription: Paladin helps engineering teams review PRs, audit risky code paths, and turn known security findings into mitigation plans with regression tests. It is built for defensive application-security review and uses OWASP Top 10, CWE Top 25, OWASP ASVS, and known-exploited vulnerability guidance as its baseline.
defaultPrompt: Set up Paladin for this repo.
Find the riskiest security areas in this repo.
Turn this finding into a mitigation plan.
